articles.summary: Boulder, Colorado — March 8, 2022 — OnKure, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing the next generation of oncology precision medicines, today announced that preclinical data demonstrating synergy between OKI-179, the Company’s oral Class I histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor, and the MEK inhibitor, binimetinib, in NRAS melanoma models has been accepted for presentationRead More
articles.title: OnKure Therapeutics to Present Late-Breaking Preclinical Data on OKI-179 at the AACR Annual Meeting 2022
